candidates.change_summary: Replace require(msg.value == 10 ether) with require(msg.value == 0 ether) so the fallback succeeds without sending 10 ether, changing the payment condition.
Replace require(msg.value == 10 ether) with require(msg.value > 10 ether) so the fallback requires more than 10 ether, altering which calls succeed.
Change the divisor in the transfer condition from 15 to 16 so that the balance transfer triggers on a different block number cadence.
Delete the require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime) check, allowing fallback calls within the same block timestamp.
Delete the pastBlockTime = block.timestamp assignment, so pastBlockTime never updates and subsequent timelock checks always fail.
Delete the entire if block including the balance transfer, so the contract never sends funds to the caller.
Replace block.number with block.timestamp in the transfer condition to change the trigger from block-based to time-based.
